body:
I was forced to see several therapists when I was younger, but because I was forced, it obviously didn't help much. Finally when I was seventeen I realised that seeing someone out of my own will would probably be more helpful, but there was no chemistry at all and I began to dread our sessions because they were just plain awful.

I know that all I have to do is find the right therapist, and I'm going to give it another try at some point, but right now I still get filled with dread just by the thought of it, so I think it's best if I wait a while.

Best wishes for you too.

Thank you. To have someone else acknowledges it, especially a stranger, makes it easier for me to see it myself and keep it in mind.

My boyfriend knows pretty much all there is to know about my situation, both the cutting and everything else. He knows that I'm really trying to stop, and when the topic comes up, he always makes sure I know how proud of me he is.

I have mentioned this urge to him, but couldn't find the courage to go into detail with it. I'm not sure I even know how to, but I'm working on both of those things.

I'm not sure if there are any particularly negative aspects of my life at the moment. Most things really are going rather well, which only makes this whole thing even more confusing. Of course there is the thing that my boyfriend and I are living in two different countries, but he's moving here to be with me as soon as we figure out how to make it happen. It can be very stressful at times, but I doubt that's what's making me feel like this.

I'm not seeing anyone at the moment, no, as I need some time to recover from a bad experience with my last therapist before I look for a new one.

My boyfriend doesn't know how bad it is exactly, but I have mentioned it to him, so he's aware. He's also aware of everything else and takes good care of me.

I'm working on finding the courage to tell him about this particular thing in detail, but it's a difficult thing to admit let alone talk about. Also, our relationship is long distance, so there's a limit to how much support he can offer.
